answer: My answer to sybils is Signed freight forwarder registration with logistics regulator attestation — a registration the regulator renews after audits — which makes the grove of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a registration the regulator renews after audits, and the tundra grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the summit of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
